title: TensixFlow Plan
description: Validation contract for the plan/perf/viz JSON shared by the scheduler, the plan report, and the HTML visualizer. Field names are snake_case to match the project report format. Every perf number is a static projection, never a measured hardware value.

graph_id.description: Identifier of the fused graph this plan schedules (e.g. "rmsnorm_matmul").

device.description: Device the plan was scheduled for. Values are copied from spec/devices.json through the generated device table; the name must exist there.

name.description: Device name or alias from spec/devices.json (e.g. "n150").

grid_x.description: Compute grid extent on the X axis, per die.

grid_y.description: Compute grid extent on the Y axis, per die.

l1_usable_bytes.description: Usable L1 bytes per Tensix core.

flops_per_cycle_per_core.description: Matrix unit FLOPs per cycle per core at one fidelity phase.

dram_bandwidth_bytes_per_second.description: Published DRAM bandwidth in bytes per second (board aggregate for two-chip products).

activation_sharding.description: Optional report field: activation sharding scheme, e.g. "row-major". Emitted at the top level by tensixflow-translate; mirrors layout.activation_sharding. Not required so plan::toJson output stays valid.

weight_strategy.description: Optional report field: weight distribution strategy ("replicate"/"shard"/"multicast"). Emitted at the top level by tensixflow-translate; mirrors layout.weight_strategy.

intermediate_storage.description: Optional report field: where the fused intermediate is stored ("L1" when fused, else "DRAM").

fusion.description: Optional report field: the fusion decision ("fused_rmsnorm_matmul"/"fused_mlp"/"none").

estimated_dram_reads_saved.description: Optional report field: projected DRAM read bytes saved by fusion (the intermediate that no longer round-trips DRAM); 0 when unfused.

estimated_intermediate_writes_saved.description: Optional report field: projected intermediate DRAM write bytes saved by fusion; 0 when unfused.

grid_y.description: Core-grid height (the device compute grid Y extent).

grid_x.description: Core-grid width (the device compute grid X extent).

emission.description: Projected emitted-path accounting: what the emitted TT-Metalium program will do with the plan's tile geometry. Every value is projected from static shapes, never measured.

mapping.description: Output-tile mapping name. The emitter supports "output-tile-ranges" (each core owns a contiguous range of linear output-tile ids) and "blocked-reuse" (each core owns a 2D block and stages its activation row block and weight column block in L1 once).

cores_used.description: Cores the emitted program assigns output tiles to: min(grid cores, output tiles).

max_tiles_per_core.description: Largest number of output tiles one core owns: ceil(output tiles / cores used).

dram_read_bytes.description: Projected DRAM read bytes of the emitted program under the recorded mapping. For output-tile-ranges: output tiles * K tiles * 2 * tile bytes. For blocked-reuse: K tiles * used column blocks * activation row tiles plus K tiles * (used row blocks when the weight is unicast, else 1) * weight column tiles. The activation read is replicated across the used column blocks, so this is an upper bound.

dram_write_bytes.description: Projected DRAM write bytes of the emitted program: output tiles * tile bytes, one result tile per output tile in both mappings.

fused_stage_tiles.description: Tiles a fused variant would stage per core: max rows per core * K tiles.

fused_feasible.description: True when a fused variant would fit the per-core circular-buffer budget.

est_cycles.description: Projected total cycles from the static roofline model.

suggestions.description: Suggested optimizations derived from the plan.
